quotes.text: Of course but the technology is moving very quickly. It's new modules and new things every week but getting people to actually change your habits takes time.
quotes.speaker: Christoffer Besler Hansen
quotes.why: Sums up why AI adoption is a people problem more than a technology problem.

quotes.text: I still see a lot of customers just purchasing licenses and expecting people to learn it themselves and I don't believe that works for any of them.
quotes.speaker: Christoffer Besler Hansen
quotes.why: A clear warning against license-only Copilot rollouts.

quotes.text: what we are trying to do internally when we are using or say having user adoption is that we don't ask AI first, but you think first yourself.
quotes.speaker: Christoffer Besler Hansen
quotes.why: A practical habit for using AI as a thinking partner.

quotes.text: I think the most important thing to do is that the users are getting tools that are as good as possible to kind of combat them using a shadow AI tools.
quotes.speaker: Christoffer Besler Hansen
quotes.why: Recommends good sanctioned tools over bans to fight shadow AI.

quotes.text: I think being an experimenter and testing out the solutions, finding out how does AI work in what I'm good at, how can I become even better at what I do with AI. I think it's the best way to stay relevant
quotes.speaker: Christoffer Besler Hansen
quotes.why: Concrete career advice for staying relevant in the age of AI.

chapters.title: What an AI workplace is and why training matters
Time savings, Researcher and preparing data
From Copilot to agents and Copilot Studio
Agents that take actions, guardrails and the Agent 365 SDK
Agent lifecycle, shadow AI, FinOps and the future of work

takeaways: Buying Copilot licenses is not enough; continuous, role-based training is what keeps people using AI after the first few weeks.
Organizations should measure AI value against real business outcomes, prepare and label their data, and move step by step from informational agents to agents that take actions with guardrails.
Agent sprawl, shadow AI and rising token costs call for lifecycle policies, good sanctioned tools and FinOps thinking about which model and tool to use for each task.
hook: Rolling out Microsoft 365 Copilot is easy; getting thousands of employees to use it and proving value is not. Microsoft MVP Christoffer Besler Hansen of Atea shares practical lessons for IT and business leaders on adoption, agents, Copilot Studio, governance and cost control on the way to a real AI workplace.
